activities.title: Start Here: Your Fashion English Course
activities.summary: A short welcome task that introduces the weekly course rhythm and asks students to think about why English matters in Fashion Design.

en.title: Start Here: Your Fashion English Course
en.summary: Learn how the week works and think about your English goals for Fashion Design.
en.instructions: Read the short welcome, look at the weekly routine, and choose one reason you want to study English for Fashion Design.
success_criteria: I can identify the main parts of the weekly routine.
I can name one reason English is useful in Fashion Design.
sentence_frames: I want to learn English for ___.
English can help me with ___.

pt.title: Comece Aqui: Seu Curso de Ingles para Moda
pt.summary: Entenda como a semana funciona e pense nos seus objetivos de ingles para Design de Moda.
pt.instructions: Leia a breve apresentacao, observe a rotina da semana e escolha um motivo para estudar ingles para Design de Moda.
success_criteria: Eu consigo identificar as partes principais da rotina semanal.
Eu consigo dizer um motivo pelo qual o ingles e util no Design de Moda.
sentence_frames: I want to learn English for ___.
English can help me with ___.

activities.teacher_instructions: Briefly introduce the course rhythm and invite students to connect English to a real Fashion Design task such as sketch captions, portfolio texts, or class vocabulary.

input.prompt_en: Why do you want to learn English for Fashion Design?
input.prompt_pt: Por que voce quer aprender ingles para Design de Moda?

steps.title: Notice the weekly routine
steps.student_action_en: Look at the weekly routine and identify reading, listening, writing, and feedback.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe a rotina semanal e identifique leitura, escuta, escrita e feedback.
steps.teacher_action: Point out that the same rhythm will return in later weeks.

steps.title: Choose your goal
steps.student_action_en: Choose one reason English is useful for your Fashion Design studies.
steps.student_action_pt: Escolha um motivo pelo qual o ingles e util para os seus estudos de Design de Moda.
steps.teacher_action: Invite a few volunteers to share one reason aloud.

expected_output.description_en: A short personal reason for studying English in Fashion Design.
expected_output.description_pt: Um motivo pessoal curto para estudar ingles em Design de Moda.

completion_criteria_en: The student identifies the weekly routine.
The student gives one relevant reason for learning English.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno identifica a rotina semanal.
O aluno apresenta um motivo relevante para aprender ingles.
checklist_pt: Eu escolhi um objetivo de aprendizagem.
assessment.model_response_en: English can help me describe my sketches and write portfolio texts.
assessment.model_response_pt: O ingles pode me ajudar a descrever meus croquis e a escrever textos para o portfolio.
common_errors: Very broad answers with no link to Fashion Design.
feedback_prompts_en: Can you connect your answer to one real class or project?
feedback_prompts_pt: Voce pode relacionar sua resposta a uma aula ou projeto real?

support: Provide three example reasons on the board.
challenge: Ask students to give one extra example connected to a portfolio or studio task.

extension_options: Share your answer with a partner and find one similar goal.
activities.notes_for_app_design: This can become a simple onboarding screen with one reflection prompt and a completion checkpoint.

activities.title: Meet Ana, a Fashion Design Student
activities.summary: Students read a short profile about a Fashion Design student and notice how course identity language works in context.

en.title: Meet Ana, a Fashion Design Student
en.summary: Read a short profile and find key details about Ana's studies and goals.
en.instructions: Read Ana's profile, look at the support image, and answer the comprehension questions.
success_criteria: I can identify what Ana studies.
I can find one class and one English goal in the text.
sentence_frames: Ana studies ___.
She wants to learn English for ___.

pt.title: Conheca Ana, uma estudante de Design de Moda
pt.summary: Leia um perfil curto e encontre detalhes importantes sobre os estudos e os objetivos da Ana.
pt.instructions: Leia o perfil da Ana, observe a imagem de apoio e responda as perguntas de compreensao.
success_criteria: Eu consigo identificar o que a Ana estuda.
Eu consigo localizar uma disciplina e um objetivo de ingles no texto.
sentence_frames: Ana studies ___.
She wants to learn English for ___.

activities.teacher_instructions: Use the text as a model for the later writing task. Highlight the sentence frames students can reuse in their own profile.

input.prompt_en: Find the main study details in Ana's profile.
input.prompt_pt: Encontre os principais detalhes de estudo no perfil da Ana.

items.label_en: Why does she want to learn English?
items.label_pt: Por que ela quer aprender ingles?

steps.title: Read for the main idea
steps.student_action_en: Read the profile once and decide who Ana is.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia o perfil uma vez e identifique quem e Ana.
steps.teacher_action: Remind students not to translate every word before finding the main idea.

steps.title: Find the details
steps.student_action_en: Read again and find one class, one interest, and one English goal.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia novamente e encontre uma disciplina, um interesse e um objetivo de ingles.
steps.teacher_action: Monitor and point students back to sentence frames if needed.

expected_output.description_en: Short answers showing understanding of Ana's study profile.
expected_output.description_pt: Respostas curtas que mostram compreensao do perfil de estudos da Ana.

completion_criteria_en: The student identifies Ana's course correctly.
The student finds at least one accurate goal from the text.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno identifica corretamente o curso da Ana.
O aluno encontra pelo menos um objetivo correto no texto.
assessment.model_response_en: Ana studies Fashion Design and wants to learn English for vocabulary and portfolio texts.
assessment.model_response_pt: Ana estuda Design de Moda e quer aprender ingles para vocabulario e textos de portfolio.
common_errors: Copying isolated words without identifying the goal.
feedback_prompts_en: Which sentence in the text helped you find the answer?
feedback_prompts_pt: Qual frase do texto ajudou voce a encontrar a resposta?

support: Underline the sentence frames in the text before the second reading.
challenge: Ask students to infer one likely future goal Ana may have.

extension_options: Compare Ana's interests with your own.
activities.notes_for_app_design: This activity can become a short reading card with image support and auto-check questions.

activities.title: Listen: My First Week in Fashion Design
activities.summary: Students listen to a short first-semester introduction and identify classes, interests, and language goals.

en.title: Listen: My First Week in Fashion Design
en.summary: Listen to a student introduction and catch key details.
en.instructions: Listen to the audio two times and note what the student studies, likes, and wants to learn.
success_criteria: I can identify the student's course.
I can hear one class and one English goal.
sentence_frames: The student likes ___.
The student wants to learn English for ___.

pt.title: Escute: Minha primeira semana em Design de Moda
pt.summary: Escute a apresentacao de um estudante e identifique detalhes importantes.
pt.instructions: Escute o audio duas vezes e anote o que o estudante estuda, de que gosta e o que quer aprender.
success_criteria: Eu consigo identificar o curso do estudante.
Eu consigo ouvir uma disciplina e um objetivo de ingles.
sentence_frames: The student likes ___.
The student wants to learn English for ___.

activities.teacher_instructions: If audio is not yet available, read the script aloud slowly. Emphasize the course words students will reuse in their writing.
materials: audio clip or teacher read-aloud script

input.prompt_en: Listen and identify the main study details.
input.prompt_pt: Escute e identifique os principais detalhes de estudo.

items.label_en: Which classes does the student mention?
Why does the student want English?
items.label_pt: Por que o estudante quer aprender ingles?

steps.title: Listen for the big picture
steps.student_action_en: Listen once and decide who is speaking and what they study.
steps.student_action_pt: Escute uma vez e identifique quem esta falando e o que essa pessoa estuda.
steps.teacher_action: Set a clear purpose before the first play.

steps.title: Listen for details
steps.student_action_en: Listen again and note one class, one interest, and one reason for learning English.
steps.student_action_pt: Escute novamente e anote uma disciplina, um interesse e um motivo para aprender ingles.
steps.teacher_action: Pause between plays if learners need more support.

expected_output.description_en: Short notes or answers showing listening comprehension.
expected_output.description_pt: Anotacoes ou respostas curtas que mostram compreensao auditiva.

completion_criteria_en: The student identifies the speaker as a Fashion Design student.
The student catches at least two accurate details.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno identifica o falante como estudante de Design de Moda.
O aluno percebe pelo menos dois detalhes corretos.
checklist_en: I listened for the main idea.
checklist_pt: Eu escutei para entender a ideia principal.
Eu escutei novamente para identificar detalhes.
assessment.model_response_en: The student studies Fashion Design, likes sketches and fabric, and wants English for vocabulary and portfolio texts.
assessment.model_response_pt: O estudante estuda Design de Moda, gosta de croquis e tecido, e quer ingles para vocabulario e textos de portfolio.
common_errors: Missing the reason for learning English.
feedback_prompts_en: What words helped you identify the student's goal?
feedback_prompts_pt: Quais palavras ajudaram voce a identificar o objetivo do estudante?

support: Allow one extra replay with a visible keyword bank.
challenge: Ask students to paraphrase one idea instead of repeating exact words.

extension_options: Use the audio as a pronunciation model for one sentence.
activities.notes_for_app_design: This activity needs audio playback plus a text-script fallback for accessibility and teacher use.

activities.title: Build Your Fashion Student Profile
activities.summary: Students write a short guided profile using identity, course, interest, and English-goal language from the week.

en.title: Build Your Fashion Student Profile
en.summary: Write a short profile about yourself as a Fashion Design student.
en.instructions: Use the sentence frames to write 50-80 words about who you are, what you study, what you like, and why you want English.
success_criteria: I write about my studies and interests.
I include one reason I want to learn English.
I use at least three Fashion Design words.
sentence_frames: My name is ___.
I am a Fashion Design student.
I like ___.
I want to learn English for ___.

pt.title: Monte o seu perfil de estudante de Moda
pt.summary: Escreva um perfil curto sobre voce como estudante de Design de Moda.
pt.instructions: Use as frases-modelo para escrever de 50 a 80 palavras sobre quem voce e, o que estuda, do que gosta e por que quer aprender ingles.
success_criteria: Eu escrevo sobre meus estudos e interesses.
Eu incluo um motivo para querer aprender ingles.
Eu uso pelo menos tres palavras de Design de Moda.
sentence_frames: My name is ___.
I am a Fashion Design student.
I like ___.
I want to learn English for ___.

activities.teacher_instructions: Model a short profile before students write. Prioritize clear meaning, basic sentence control, and relevant fashion vocabulary over perfect accuracy.

input.prompt_en: Write a short Fashion Design student profile.
input.prompt_pt: Escreva um perfil curto de estudante de Design de Moda.

steps.title: Plan your ideas
steps.student_action_en: Choose your main details: what you study, what you like, and why you want English.
steps.student_action_pt: Escolha suas informacoes principais: o que voce estuda, do que gosta e por que quer aprender ingles.
steps.teacher_action: Prompt students to stay close to real Fashion Design interests.

steps.title: Write the profile
steps.student_action_en: Use the sentence frames to write your profile in English.
steps.student_action_pt: Use as frases-modelo para escrever seu perfil em ingles.
steps.teacher_action: Circulate and help students fix missing verbs or articles when they block meaning.

steps.title: Review one sentence
steps.student_action_en: Read your profile again and improve one sentence before you submit it.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia seu perfil novamente e melhore uma frase antes de envia-lo.
steps.teacher_action: Ask students to check sentence starts, verb use, and clear vocabulary choices.

expected_output.description_en: A short self-introduction profile connected to Fashion Design study.
expected_output.description_pt: Um perfil curto de autoapresentacao ligado aos estudos de Design de Moda.

completion_criteria_en: The profile includes study identity, interest, and English goal.
The profile is understandable and connected to Fashion Design.
completion_criteria_pt: O perfil inclui identidade de estudo, interesse e objetivo de ingles.
O perfil e compreensivel e conectado ao Design de Moda.
checklist_en: I used at least three Fashion Design words.
I checked one sentence before submitting.
checklist_pt: Eu usei pelo menos tres palavras de Design de Moda.
Eu revisei uma frase antes de enviar.

rubric.criterion: Use of Fashion Design identity language
rubric.excellent_en: The profile clearly introduces the student and connects English to real Fashion Design study goals.
rubric.excellent_pt: O perfil apresenta claramente o estudante e conecta o ingles a objetivos reais de estudo em Design de Moda.
rubric.satisfactory_en: The profile introduces the student and includes a basic study goal.
rubric.satisfactory_pt: O perfil apresenta o estudante e inclui um objetivo basico de estudo.
rubric.needs_work_en: The profile needs a clearer connection to the student's studies or goals.
rubric.needs_work_pt: O perfil precisa de uma conexao mais clara com os estudos ou objetivos do estudante.

assessment.model_response_en: My name is Mariana. I am a Fashion Design student. I study at university in Brazil. I like sketching garments and working with fabric. I want to learn English for fashion vocabulary and portfolio texts.
assessment.model_response_pt: Meu nome e Mariana. Eu sou estudante de Design de Moda. Estudo na universidade no Brasil. Gosto de fazer croquis de roupas e trabalhar com tecido. Quero aprender ingles para vocabulario de moda e textos de portfolio.
common_errors: Using Portuguese word order in English sentences.
Writing very general goals with no Fashion Design context.
feedback_prompts_en: Can you add one clearer Fashion Design detail?
Can you improve one sentence with 'I am' or 'I want to'?
feedback_prompts_pt: Voce pode acrescentar um detalhe mais claro de Design de Moda?
Voce pode melhorar uma frase usando 'I am' ou 'I want to'?

support: Allow students to build the profile from a sentence bank before writing independently.
challenge: Invite students to add one sentence about a future design interest such as sustainability or accessories.

extension_options: Turn the written profile into a short spoken introduction for the teacher session.
activities.notes_for_app_design: This needs a text-entry component with saved drafts, sentence-frame support, and teacher review visibility.
